children: Euro zone consumer confidence fell by 1.0 points in September from the August number, figures released on Tuesday showed.
The European Commission said a flash estimate showed euro zone consumer morale decreased to -16.5 this month from -15.5 in August.
Economists polled by Reuters had expected a fall to -16.0.
In the European Union as a whole, consumer sentiment fell by 0.8 points to -15.8.
